avis.titre: Rich, effective night cream that delivers visible hydration
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Night Cream (50ml) and I’m really impressed with how well it works. The texture is rich but not heavy, and it sinks in nicely without leaving my skin greasy. By the next morning, my skin feels soft, smooth, and noticeably more hydrated. The hyaluronic acid really helps plump the skin, especially around fine lines, and my face looks fresher and more rested when I wake up. It hasn’t caused any irritation or breakouts, and it works well with other products in my routine. A little goes a long way, so the jar lasts longer than expected. The formula feels high-quality and the results speak for themselves. If you’re looking for a night cream that deeply moisturises and helps improve the look of fine lines, this one is definitely worth trying.
Although it's pricy, it's worth trying - like all Eucerin products!
